name: Poke

note.en: OAuth (DCR, or a client set up in a Template) or an API key.
note.pt: OAuth (DCR, ou cliente configurado num Template) ou chave de API.

plans.en: Any Poke user, from the web app.
plans.pt: Qualquer pessoa que usa o Poke, pelo app web.

limits.en: Remote only; local servers need `npx poke@latest tunnel <local-url>`.
limits.pt: Só remoto; servidor local precisa de `npx poke@latest tunnel <url-local>`.

limits.en: An API key inside a shared prefilled link is visible to anyone with the link.
limits.pt: Uma chave de API dentro de um link compartilhado fica visível para quem tiver o link.

limits.en: Poke recommends Recipes (poke.com/kitchen) for distribution: you can change the server later and earn from usage.
limits.pt: O Poke recomenda Recipes (poke.com/kitchen) para distribuir: dá para mudar o servidor depois e ganhar com o uso.

note.en: Check the fields and click **Create Integration**.
note.pt: Confira os campos e clique em **Create Integration**.

notes: Servers receive X-Poke-User-Id for per-user scoping.
